text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Backend Engineer position at Cobalt Fintech. As a Computer Science and Engineering student at the Pune Institute of Technology, I have built a strong foundation in software development, data structures, and database management, and I am eager to contribute my technical skills to your engineering team.

Throughout my academic projects and internship experience, I have focused on building robust, containerised applications and working with relational databases. During my time as a Machine Learning Intern at Brightcart Retail Analytics, I built a retrieval-augmented chatbot over 4,000 product manuals using Python, FastAPI, and pgvector. By tuning chunk size and prompts based on an evaluation set of 150 questions, I raised answer accuracy from 71% to 86%. I also containerised the service with Docker and deployed it on a company virtual machine. 

Additionally, my technical toolkit includes proficiency in Python, JavaScript, SQL, C++, and PostgreSQL, alongside hands-on experience with Docker and Git. In my project StudyBuddy, I developed an application using Python, the Gemini API, and React that generates flashcards from uploaded PDFs with structured JSON output validated by Pydantic, which was used by 120 classmates during end-semester exams. My ability to design structured data solutions and build dependable software is further demonstrated by my recognition as a finalist in the Smart India Hackathon 2025.

While my background includes strong experience with Python, SQL, and Docker, I am enthusiastic about applying my core computer science training to learn and work extensively with Java and Kotlin, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis in your backend environment. 

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my technical background and dedication can support Cobalt Fintech.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
